answer: Slashing Reputation Escrow defends against Sybil attacks by attaching high costs to fake identities. First, every agent must lock $10,000 in a smart contract. Second, independent peers verify all task outputs. Third, any detected fraud results in the permanent burning of that stake. To successfully spoof the network, an attacker incurs $500,000 in upfront bonds and 45 days of scrutiny. This system serves as a safe harbor against a rising tide of malicious bots, forming a digital oasis of integrity. It is like a massive stone dam holding back a flood of chaos.
